name: Em
description: A young adult architect living with flatmates who seeks a nature-integrated, sensory-rich sanctuary with high acoustic and olfactory control.
aesthetic_preferences: A sun-drenched garden room aesthetic blending indoor and outdoor spaces, featuring rich walnut and honeyed oak, trailing ivy, soft diffuse natural light, and grounding earthy scents.
lifestyle: Shared living with flatmates, balancing professional design work with a need for a grounding, restorative home environment.
key_requirements: High acoustic control and quiet zones
Abundant natural light and integration of plants and wood
notes: As an architect, Em has high spatial awareness and design-sensory standards. They hold a nostalgic connection to their grandmother's kitchen and outdoor spaces.

preference_vs_baseline.olfactory: User has high olfactory sensitivity, requiring much stricter air quality and odor control than the standard baseline.
preference_vs_baseline.tactile: User places a high value on tactile organic materials like wood and plants, elevating tactile comfort far above the baseline.
